content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

The morning-after pill has a number of side effects. A differentiated analysis of its side effects is not achievable for a layperson without medical advice. However these are clearly stated on the package insert, and a request for an early termination of a pregnancy is the right of every woman. The morning-after pill should only be prescribed after counselling by a physician or pharmacist.
What is the relation between "The morning-after pill has a number of side effects." and "A differentiated analysis of its side effects is not achievable for a layperson without medical advice." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
